summary: The Verge's Sheena Vasani, writing on Dec. 24, 2023, compiles more than 40 digital gifts, including gift cards and subscriptions, that can be bought as late as Christmas Day. The list is organized by interest: film and TV, gaming, travel, health and wellness, food, music, books, and creative pursuits. Prices, retailers and some deals are noted for each pick, with generic retailer gift cards offered as a fallback.
one_line: The Verge's last-minute Christmas 2023 guide to over 40 digital gifts, sorted by interest, with subscriptions, gift cards and prices.
key_facts: The Verge article by Sheena Vasani was published on December 24, 2023, the day before Christmas, and lists digital gifts that can be bought as late as Christmas Day.
The Disney Bundle with ads costs $14.99 a month and includes Disney Plus, Hulu, and ESPN Plus.
PlayStation Plus memberships start at $9.99 a month, and a three-month PlayStation Plus gift card costs $30 at Amazon, Best Buy, and Target.
Nintendo Switch Online starts at $19.99 a year and offers more than 70 retro games from the NES, SNES, and original Game Boy eras.
Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack costs $49.99 for an individual plan, while the family plan, which allows up to eight accounts, is $71.89 ($8 off) via gift card at Amazon and Walmart.
Rosetta Stone is offering up to 50 percent off, with the 12-month single-language tier starting at $126 ($42 off).
Peloton's monthly subscription costs $12.99 and does not require owning a Peloton device; Headspace costs $12.99 monthly or $69.99 annually.
Fitbit Premium starts at $9.99 a month, and one-on-one health coaching costs an extra $54.99 per month.
Goldbelly's three-month ice cream subscription costs $299.85, and Eater Wine Club costs $70 for two or four bottles of wine each month.
Sur La Table online cooking classes start at $29 per household and run 90 to 120 minutes each.
Apple Music offers more than 100 million ad-free songs and has no dedicated gift card, so buyers must use a regular Apple gift card.
Tidal starts at $10.99 per month, with $9 extra per month for lossless FLAC, Dolby Atmos Music, and Sony's 360 Reality Audio.
Comixology Unlimited costs $5.99 a month for over 45,000 comics and graphic novels and more than 2,400 manga titles.
Adobe Creative Cloud costs $59.99 per month, and Codecademy's career-change plan is $120 a year (half off) with promo code BYE2023.
MasterClass memberships start at $10 a month, and the company is currently throwing in a second membership for free.
